title: SOUTHWEST AIRLINES TO DISCUSS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS ON OCTOBER 22, 2026

body_markdown:
DALLAS


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Southwest Airlines Co](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788118-1&h=240976615&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2F%3FSRC%3DIRPRQ3EARN261022&a=Southwest+Airlines+Co) . (NYSE: LUV) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. Management will discuss the results during a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


Southwest Airlines Q3 2026 Earnings Conference Call
Thursday, October 22, 2026
10:00 AM Eastern Time
[Visit Southwest Airlines Investor Relations for the Webcast](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4788118-1&h=2725422949&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.southwest.com%2F&a=Visit+Southwest+Airlines+Investor+Relations+for+the+Webcast)


Registration for this event begins 20 minutes before the call. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Southwest Airlines Investor Relations website.
